channelIntro.title: Why would you hide or restrict a question?
channelIntro.body1: "Visible on the listing page" shows the question on the accommodation's page and in the structured data (JSON-LD) search engines read. "Usable by AI" lets the chat assistant use this question to answer guest queries.
channelIntro.body2: Uncheck "Visible on the listing page" for information that's useful to know but that you don't want published: something temporary ("the pool is under repair until November"), a margin you'd rather not promise in writing ("there's flexibility on late check-out if there's no next booking"), or a tip that reads better in a conversation than on the storefront ("at night it's best to call a taxi").
channelIntro.body3: Uncheck "Usable by AI" for content you want shown exactly as written, without the assistant rephrasing it — legal text or exact cancellation terms, for example.
channelIntro.body4: Important: a question that isn't visible on the listing but is usable by AI is not private. The assistant can still say it to anyone who asks in chat; it just won't be published on the page.
